$schema_comment: Patterns for scripts/check-community-review.mjs — keep in sync with docs/community-review.md

rules.description: Do not assign el.style.* directly; use classes or setCssProps(--*) only
Use createEl / createDiv instead of document.createElement
Avoid !important in plugin CSS; raise specificity or use variables

accepted.note: Listing vault files is required (image picker / folder export). Review may flag vault enumeration; we accept it.
Copy-to-clipboard is a core feature. Review may flag clipboard access; we accept it.
Settings still implement display() for Obsidian older than 1.13 (minAppVersion 1.5.7). Newer APIs are also present (Path B).
